description: This file defines a windowing provider class 'WindowSDL' based on SDL3, including event handling, window management, input processing, and related classes for touch events, specifically for the Kivy framework.

classes.name: SDL3MotionEvent
classes.description: Represents a touch motion event for SDL3, extending Kivy's MotionEvent with profile 'pos' and 'pressure'.

classes.name: SDL3MotionEventProvider
classes.description: Provides touch input events for SDL3, managing a queue of events and touch mappings.

classes.name: WindowSDL
classes.description: A window class based on SDL3, handling window creation, event processing, input, window management, and integration with Kivy.

methods.name: depach
methods.description: Unpacks input args into touch position and pressure.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Processes queued touch events and dispatches them.

methods.name: _event_filter
methods.description: Handles various window and input events, dispatching appropriate actions.

methods.name: create_window
methods.description: Initializes and creates the window, setting up event filters, input providers, and window properties.

methods.name: _update_dpi
methods.description: Updates window DPI based on display scale.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes and tears down the window.

methods.name: maximize
methods.description: Maximizes the window on desktop platforms.

methods.name: minimize
methods.description: Minimizes the window on desktop platforms.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores the window from minimized/maximized state.

methods.name: raise_window
methods.description: Raises the window to the front.

methods.name: screenshot
methods.description: Captures a screenshot of the window.

methods.name: flip
methods.description: Swaps the front and back buffers.

methods.name: _is_shapable
methods.description: Checks if window shape can be set.

methods.name: _fix_mouse_pos
methods.description: Converts mouse position to density-scaled coordinates.

methods.name: mainloop
methods.description: Runs the main event loop, processing window and input events.

methods.name: do_pause
methods.description: Pauses the application, handling app backgrounding and foregrounding.

methods.name: _update_modifiers
methods.description: Updates the list of active modifier keys based on SDL key states.

methods.name: request_keyboard
methods.description: Requests keyboard input with callback and input type.

methods.name: _check_keyboard_shown
methods.description: Checks if the keyboard is shown and releases if not.

methods.name: map_key
methods.description: Maps an original key to a new key code.
